Why Rosé

Love, designed
thoughtfully.

We didn't build just another swipe app. We built a place where real connections bloom. Here's what makes Rosé truly special.

🧠
AI Heart Match

Our AI understands your personality, values and what you truly want — not just your photos. Meet people who get you on a deeper level.

🛡️
100% Verified

Every profile is verified with ID and a face scan. If someone is on Rosé, they're real. Safety and trust are our top priority.

🎉
IRL Events

Skip the awkward DMs — meet at one of our curated events, speed dates, and social mixers in your city. The vibes are always immaculate.

🎨
Express Yourself

Add video intros, voice notes, photo grids, and personality prompts that show the real, beautiful, whole you.

🌍
Local & Global

Find someone next door or across the world. Rosé's smart location features make distance feel like nothing at all.

🔐
Privacy First

Your data is yours. Blurred photos until you match. Full control over who sees you. Your peace of mind is everything to us.
